title: Fixed-right-map exact B/A expected internal charge identity
statement: For every h>=1 and every complete original right-line global injection g, E_f[I_L^(BA,int)(f,g) | g]=p_B(s)*T_g where f is sampled ONCE uniformly from complete original point global injections, p_B(s)=K*C(a-2,4)*3*4!/(K)_5; all genuine original six-incidence sets Q share the same f,g.

quantifiers.domain: arbitrary fixed complete globally injected original line map
one uniformly sampled complete globally injected original point map; fixed same g

external_dependencies: AA4-M original full injection five-factor marginal and exact seven GF(5) positional classifier.
limitations: Expectation does not imply all-f individual lower bound.
Identity alone does not imply a positive T_g lower bound.
No universal inf_(f,g) positive motif result.
falsification_boundary: Conditioning holds g fixed and draws a single coherent global f; per-Q independent physical relabeling is forbidden.
